NewsArticle.Title: Developments for March
NewsArticle.Content:
The world of Temuair has remained within its current borders for a while now. It is time to expand those regions and allow access to new areas as well as some old. To this end, the following are scheduled for release in March:
New Town - Many Aislings are interested in moving to a new town. So, King Bruce is looking at which new town his subjects would like to see opened to citizenship. A new metropolis of Loures could be made available, or perhaps a smaller town of Undine or Piet or even the unknown town of Tagor. To vote, send an email to aisling@nexon.net with the word "Town" in the subject line along with the name of the town you would like opened. The votes will be tabulated on Thrusday, 3/1/01 and the one with the most votes will be opened in March.
Pits of Chaos - There have been rumors with the introduction of Necromancy that the borders between the Aisling reality and that of other worlds have begun to thin. Now, a small pocket of Chaos is erupting, with hideous demonic creatures within. The area will be only for those of the highest Insight, with a special seven area region for Masters.
Druid Circle - With the coming of Evil and Chaos, there is bound to be an influx of Good and Order. A Druidic Circle is being erected and from there, missions of peace and security will be found.
Fairs - The Mundanes are crafting the Mileth Fair so that Aislings can run their own Fairs without the intervention of the Mundanes. Hopefully, this will help to increase the economy and stimulate growth both financially and socially.
Contests - The long awaited contests are currently under judgement and all except the last three contests in February will be judged and prizes awarded by March 1st, 2001.
